{{Quote|You got it! That's the right answer. Shall we do another?|The Theed Palace librarian|<ref name="SWG" />}}
A '''librarian''' was employed at a [[Library/Legends|library]] within the [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Theed Royal Palace]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. When a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] visited the library during that [[Time/Legends|time]], the librarian offered to play a trivia game with them, which the spacer readily accepted. The librarian asked the spacer a multitude of questions, such as what [[Centerpoint Station|single center of mass]] do both [[Talus/Legends|Talus]] and [[Tralus/Legends|Tralus]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] around, and [[Exar Kun/Legends|who]] formed the [[Brotherhood of the Sith]], among many others. The spacer answered all questions correctly. The librarian, impressed, applauded the spacer's knowledge of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] and gave the spacer a badge. The librarian welcomed the spacer to return later, remarking that they might have new questions to ask them.<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateNoble.jpg|250px|thumb|Every possible depiction of the librarian]]
The "trivial librarian," as they were commonly referred to as in-game, was featured in the [[2003]] [[Wikipedia:MMORPG|massively-multiplayer online role-playing game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']]. The librarian was added to the game with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 6 Notes: 11 February 04|Publish 6]]," on [[February 11]], [[2004]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish 6: The Imperial Crackdown">{{SonyCite|url=recent_updates.jsp?o=60893|text=Publish 6: The Imperial Crackdown}}</ref> The librarian's [[Species/Legends|species]] and [[Gender/Legends|gender]], like many [[Wikipedia:Non-playable character|non-playable characters]] in the game, changed every time the game's servers were restarted.<ref name="SWG" />
